Exchange/platform: Bitbase
Headline: BITBASE Points Thanksgiving Rewards Coming Soon: Share 16,683 HYPE!
Prize pool: 16.7K HYPE
Start: not stated · End: not stated
Most one person can get (parsed): 6 HYPE
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Dear Bitbase User,
Thank you for being part of the Bitbase journey and contributing to the Bitbase ecosystem and BITBASE Points. This Thanksgiving, we've prepared a total of 16,683 HYPE in airdrop rewards, with exclusive gift boxes, limited-time tasks, and a referral campaign to look forward to.
The celebration kicks off on November 26, 2026!
1. Exclusive Gift Box Airdrop: 11,683 HYPE
Selected users will receive an invitation to claim an exclusive Thanksgiving gift in HYPE. Users eligible for the exclusive airdrop can also take part in limited-time tasks to earn extra HYPE and points.
## 2. Invite a Friend and Earn Up to 6 HYPE Combined
Invite a friend to unlock Thanksgiving rewards and earn up to 6 HYPE between you! We'll reveal how referrals work when the campaign goes live.
Full details will be available on the official campaign page at launch. Stay tuned!
